summary: KKR FS Income Trust filed a Form 8-K on October 13, 2026, reporting that its wholly owned special purpose financing subsidiary K-FIT Finance BMO-1 LLC entered into a Loan and Security Agreement dated October 7, 2026, with Bank of Montreal as administrative agent and Western Alliance Trust Company as collateral custodian. The facility provides up to $250 million in multi-currency borrowings, with a revolving period ending October 7, 2029, maturity October 7, 2031, and interest at benchmark plus a 1.85% spread. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation.
